question: Why does the live second conditional-polar residual byte recover 0.979815 at step 0 rather than the 0.992540 synthetic prediction, despite composed full-carry recovery above 0.99967?

exact_schedule.reason: The live residual source must be sampled under the same first-refresh schedule as the sealed 238-step causal parent.

required_measurements: angular and radial fractions of residual-code distortion
joint, angular, conditional-radius, and marginal-radius entropy
active joint, angle, and radius symbols
top-radius frequency and energy plus max-radius-to-RMS
residual-center energy relative to residual-target energy
counterfactual codec recovery after 3, 6, and 12 Lloyd passes

aggregation.primary: residual-target-energy-weighted across all 24 matrices, reported separately at steps 0 and 8 and jointly
aggregation.secondary: unweighted extrema across matrices to expose layer-specific failures
aggregation.recovery_gain: weighted recovery at 12 Lloyd passes minus weighted recovery at 3 Lloyd passes
aggregation.center_error_share: weighted residual-center energy ratio divided by weighted three-pass distortion

lloyd_convergence_fix.interpretation: Extra fitting must both clear the old 0.98 floor with 0.0005 margin and produce a nontrivial absolute gain.

decision_policy.lloyd_convergence_fix: Authorize only one byte-neutral fit-iteration correction, followed by focused tests and an exact-config MFU and optimizer-overhead gate. No endpoint yet.
decision_policy.angular_allocation_fix: Authorize only one second-byte angular/radial reallocation at unchanged two-byte storage, then repeat the temporal direction gate. No endpoint yet.
decision_policy.radial_companding_fix: Authorize only one second-byte radial initialization or companding correction at unchanged two-byte storage, then repeat the temporal direction gate. No endpoint yet.
decision_policy.center_gauge_fix: Authorize only one byte-neutral residual-center or gauge correction, then repeat the temporal direction gate. No endpoint yet.
decision_policy.reject_two_stage_conditional_polar_famil: Close this codec family and return to a different compact temporal representation. Do not sweep bit rate, learning rate, model size, or horizon.

execution_policy.preflight: exact config, foreground-polled, MFU at least 20%
execution_policy.scientific_run: foreground-polled because the nine-update acquisition is expected to finish within five minutes; attach a persistent @Codex watchdog immediately only if observed runtime exceeds five minutes
execution_policy.callbacks: none expected for a sub-five-minute diagnostic
